_about: UI labels (en). Keys must match the other language file; tests/test_i18n.py checks this and that every t('key') used in the frontend exists.
app_tagline: From crop symptoms to smarter farming decisions
screen_crashed: This screen hit an error. Other screens still work.
profile_subtitle: Your crop details, local weather, and edits.
edit_crop: Edit crop or register a new one
variety_hint: Leave empty if you don't know it.
village_hint: Example: Sonipat, Haryana — or use your phone's location.
location_captured: Location captured. Press save to use it.
analysis_subtitle: Take a photo of one leaf to check it.
upload_tips: Tip: one leaf, filling most of the photo, in daylight. Avoid blur and shadows.
photo_too_large: Photo is larger than 8 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
model_confidence_note: Percentages show how sure the model is. These are possibilities, not a confirmed diagnosis.
crop_mismatch_note: This photo looks like a different crop than the one in your profile.
no_analysis_yet: No leaf checks yet. Upload a photo above.
finance_subtitle: Loan status, repayments, documents and schemes.
mock_loan_note: This is sample data for the demo. DharRakshak is not connected to any bank.
no_loan_yet: No loan records for this farmer yet.
documents_note: Tick a document once you've handed it to the bank. Requirements vary — confirm with your bank.
chat_subtitle: Ask about your crop or loan — type or speak, in English or Hindi.
chat_empty: Ask anything about your crop, the latest leaf check, the weather or your loan documents.
mic_blocked: Microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access in the browser, or type your question.
no_voice_for_language: This device has no Hindi voice, so answers won't be read aloud. Chrome on Android usually has one.
fallback_note: Chatbot offline — this is a saved answer.
chat_disclaimer: Answers use your saved crop and loan data. They are guidance, not a diagnosis — confirm treatments with your local agriculture office.
no_speech_heard: Couldn't hear a question. Please try again, a little closer to the microphone.
voice_unavailable: Voice input is unavailable right now. Please type your question.
